en: An old monochrome postcard view of a spa pavilion labeled "FRANZ JOSEPH-QUELLE" (Franz Joseph Spring). The ornate, vine-covered structure stands between large classical buildings. People in late 19th–early 20th century clothing stand near the spring, and a horse-drawn carriage with a driver waits on the street to the right. Printed publisher information and the caption "Karlsbad. Franz Joseph-Quelle." appear at the bottom.
